title: GridLens catalogue record
description: One JSON object per line in data/raw/catalogue.jsonl. See data/DATA_SCHEMA.md for the full field-by-field rationale -- this file is the machine-checkable contract scripts/validate_dataset.py enforces.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Never renumber/reuse an existing id -- other rows' `notes` may cross-reference it by exact string (e.g. "see ORG-AFME-0010").

institution_category.description: Empty string means not yet classified -- validate_dataset.py warns (not errors) on this, since older migrated rows may not have it yet. Fill it in for every new entry.

country_label.description: Canonical country name. Check data/DATA_SCHEMA.md's alias list before using an unfamiliar spelling.

tool_category.description: What the modelling was used for: one or more of capacity_expansion, production_cost, power_flow_dynamics, other, separated by '; '; or unspecified when the evidence names the tool but not what it was used for.

tool_explicitly_named.description: Does the source explicitly name this tool (vs. a generic "energy system model")?

use_case.description: What the tool is actually used for. Be as specific as the evidence allows -- this is what Grid Decisions classification reads.

decision_type.description: The decision the project's modelling informed (see data/DATA_SCHEMA.md). Set it with decision_basis when you review a row; left blank, scripts/sync_dataset.py applies keyword rules to use_case.

decision_basis.description: documented: the title, use case, summary or quote states the purpose; inferred: it follows only from context. Required when decision_type is set.

exact_snippet_or_quote.description: A direct quote, strongly preferred over paraphrase. See data/DATA_SCHEMA.md's evidence standards.

status.description: Only status=confirmed rows sync into the app.

batch_id.description: Free-text provenance tag for which research pass/session found this row, e.g. 'weekly_llm_scan_2027w03'. Shown to end users as the record's dataset origin.

summary.description: One sentence on what the organization did with the tool and which decision it informed, from the evidence only (e.g. 'Used PLEXOS to ...').

project_id.description: Groups multiple rows into one project. Rows with the same project_id and the same tool_name belong to the same project. If omitted, the row's id is used as the project_id.

project_title.description: A human-readable title for the project/study. Falls back to source_title of the lead row if not set.

study_countries.description: Country labels the study models (e.g. a multi-country regional study). Distinct from country_label which is the organization's home country.

study_year.description: Year of the study or decision when the source dates it; otherwise the app takes the year from source_date, the source URL or the title.

study_date.description: Date of the study as precise as the source gives it: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (publication or completion, not a page-update date). Takes precedence over study_year.

study_region.description: Region a multi-country or global study covers, e.g. 'European Union', 'Europe', 'Global'. Shown instead of a country; filtering by a country in that region includes the study.

geo_scope.description: Geographic scope of the study: 'national' (one country), 'multi_country' (regional or multiple countries), 'global' (worldwide). Auto-derived from country_label if not set.
